definitions.gloss: mind and body, mental and physical
definitions.explanation: The combination of one's mental/psychological and physical states.

examples.japanese: {心身|しんしん}ともに{健康|けんこう}でありたい。
examples.english: I want to be healthy both mentally and physically.
examples.notes: 心身ともに = both mentally and physically

examples.japanese: {心身|しんしん}の{バランス|ばらんす}を{保|たも}つことが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: It's important to maintain balance between mind and body.

examples.japanese: {過労|かろう}で{心身|しんしん}が{疲|つか}れている。
examples.english: I'm mentally and physically exhausted from overwork.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
・{心身|しんしん}ともに (both mentally and physically)
・{心身|しんしん}の{健康|けんこう} (mental and physical health)
・{心身|しんしん}の{バランス|ばらんす} (mind-body balance)
・{心身|しんしん}を{鍛|きた}える (to train mind and body)

RELATED CONCEPTS:
・{心身|しんしん}{症|しょう} (psychosomatic disorder)
・{心身|しんしん}{医学|いがく} (psychosomatic medicine)
・{心身|しんしん}{障害|しょうがい} (mental and physical disability)

SIMILAR:
・{精神|せいしん}と{肉体|にくたい} (spirit and body - more literary)
